_comment: Predicate registry. 'single_valued' predicates auto-retire a prior object during kb_extract consolidation; everything else keeps both objects. 'aliases' fold synonyms onto one canonical predicate so kb_fact_query, which matches on the predicate, does not under-return across synonym silos. Extend or override per install with <KB_DIR>/predicates.json using the same shape — 'many_valued' there removes a built-in, and 'aliases' merge with these.
